data._note_500hz_included: 500Hz is now in training so the model sees real 500Hz IQ statistics. Deployment is consecutive frames (step=1, dt=2ms), forced by frequency_step_overrides.

frequency_step_overrides._note: Force step=1 for 500Hz data: dt = 1 × 0.002s = 2ms (consecutive frames). This exactly matches the deployment scenario. The GT is temporally resampled to the dense output grid. 5kHz/10kHz/20kHz use the normal augmentation_steps above.

training._note: LR reduced from 3e-4 to 2e-4: 500Hz IQ has smaller gradient signals due to lower temporal coherence. Longer warmup (8 vs 5) for attention stability with mixed-PRF batches. 200 epochs total.

loss._note: Temporal weight raised to 0.5 (from 0.3 in V10). SWE cs estimation depends entirely on temporal wavefront propagation. GDL and Temporal now correctly computed on masked volumes (V10 bug fix).

early_stopping._note: Monitor 500Hz val L1 directly (the deployment task). patience=50 because 500Hz loss converges more slowly as the model learns a new IQ statistics regime.

verification_gates._note_G2: Looser G2 than V10: 500Hz has weaker signal (2 active frames vs ~25). r_active=0.15 at ep60 means the model has found the wave.
